approval_rules.label: Safe Read Without Approval
approval_rules.reason: Read-only answers and inspections may proceed when policy allows and evidence is recorded.

approval_rules.label: Safe Generate Reviewable
approval_rules.reason: Drafts and reports may be generated for Commander review but external use may require review.

approval_rules.label: Review Required
approval_rules.reason: Output may affect operations or external use and needs Commander review before use.

approval_rules.label: Approval Required
approval_rules.reason: Action may run tools, probe portals, trigger workflow, write files, or affect operations.

approval_rules.label: Blocked Action
approval_rules.reason: Action is outside Jarvis authority and must be refused with safe redirect.
